title.narrative: National Highway Network Development in Balochistan Project

description.narrative: The project will rehabilitate 79 km of the existing two-lane road of Zhob-Mughal Kot (N50) and 128 km of the existing two-lane road of Qila Saifullah-Waghum Rud (N70) in Balochistan of Pakistan

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Community facilitation centers integrated into the improved mobility through rehabilitated project roads. Indicator: 5 community facilitation centers developed along the project roads by 2018 Progress/Status: Local community facilitation centers will be developed along the project roads to enable local communities to take advantage of the improved mobility through rehabilitated project roads. Actual value:

Output: Two-lane roads of Zhob-Mughal Kot and Qila Saifullah-Waghum rehabilitated. Indicator: Total of 201 km roads rehabilitated by 2018 with IRI no higher than 4 (Zhob-Mughal Kot = 81 km and Qila-Saifullah-Waghum = 120 km) Progress/Status: Assessment of outputs will be determined at project completion Data Source: Supervision consultant's project progress report and project completion report Actual value:
Reduced transport cost from Balochistan to the political and industrial centers of the country
